digest.component_or_area: rebar Jira Data Center reconciler live-verification suite
propositions: The epic headline AC — a DC-created issue reaches the local store and a local edit reaches the DC issue — must be proven live against a copy of the real ticket store rather than an empty one, since a converged pass over empty input proves nothing.

The live pass must run in a fresh git repo with no remote and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and the copied store must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding and snapshot artifacts, both asserted rather than assumed, to prevent writes to production Jira.

The store-copy criterion must count local tickets on the filesystem against git ls-tree of the tickets branch, not the pass's scanned number, which counts remote Jira issues; the first dry-run must plan zero deletions and zero outbound updates.

A comprehensive fourteen-inbound/fourteen-outbound DC mutation suite must round-trip each mutation individually against a named oracle, scoped with --filter-local-ids to avoid mass-creating the whole store, with set_parent's epic case asserted directly against the transport via NotImplementedError.

Filtered passes drop inbound creates unless the filter matches the Jira key as well as the local id, and outbound update cells require a binding established via bound_dc_issue before mutating, or they falsely pass against a newly created issue.

Open findings remain: inbound edit-summary, status transition both directions, inbound link, deletion probe, inbound assignee identity minting (stores raw 'admin' not a jira-family identity), and unconvergeable outbound-update churn after convergence.
